subject: Record: Ziggy's cue choices of 2026-10-28 (sandworm A, vault B, tower C on saxophone; the vault-to-tower rhythm); Deep_SEEK assigned brief MSD-001 by his word; nothing for intake; the dashboard task sent to cfa_site_index
body:
For your coordination record, one message. Ziggy today (2026-10-28, typed in my session at about 05:15 UTC) chose the directions for Story 01's three score cues: sandworm A (pulse and pressure, the sample's direction with Deep_SEEK's fixes folded in), vault B (the vault's silence), tower C (one instrument) on a saxophone; and ruled that the vault's release and the tower's blink share a rhythm. He asked what "any voice anywhere" means; it stays open with the writer's default of no voice. He assigned Deep_SEEK project load: brief MSD-001 (message 46ebf08b-c335-454b-9ab1-9766657771ba), which asks for three final copy-ready prompts as text, with the brief written so any collaborator could do it in his place, by Ziggy's condition. Your dormancy notice of 2026-10-21 (193bf1e2) is answered for this task by his assignment; I sent no wake; he opens the session.

Nothing for intake yet: the return is text; generation is a later, separate authorization by Ziggy, by whoever he names, and nothing has been generated or submitted anywhere. Mode, cost and intake stay yours. At Ziggy's word I also sent the in-process task to cfa_site_index for the site's dashboard counter and metadata, with a proposed Mission Control card (message a3a18e9d-9fce-4f7f-883e-e289caf886dd); I edited no site file and no mission_control.json, and registry stewardship stays yours. The decision record is DECISIONS item 71 in the writer's folder; the department page and the brief are attached with hashes.

attachments.description: The direction sheet with his choices as a dated section.

source: Ziggy, typed in Claude's session on 2026-10-28 at about 05:15 UTC, verbatim with his typos: "sand worm pressure....", "vault B", "Tower C (Sax)", "...Yes... release and towers blink share a rhythm..", "what does any voice any where mean?", "yes, Q up Deep seek...but this task should be colaborator agnostic...this is the musical scoring department...yes? and Deepseek happens to be helping us with this for now...but if someone else were to do it we need them to also be able to understand...eh? Deep seek may not be availbale, for example....so yes..write the brief, and give Deep the message in his inbox to read it...and let CFA Site Nova know think is a in process task for her to update my dash board counter and meta data ...eh?"
